BevRouteEvidenceV4.description:
Describe presentation properties of one prompt-visible BEV.

These fields are retained at the reusable observation boundary for VQA V2
compatibility.  Reasoning V4.6 never treats them as route-progress,
traversability, clearance, or collision-safety supervision.

Args:
    frame: Declared BEV presentation frame.
    ego_forward: Display direction corresponding to ego forward.
    route_overlay_visible: Whether a route overlay is rendered.
    route_direction_authority: Whether clear orientation may support a
        visible task direction.
    route_progress_authority: Legacy observation metadata ignored by
        Reasoning V4.6.
    route_terminal_marker_visible: Legacy presentation metadata ignored by
        Reasoning V4.6.
    route_endpoint_semantics: Legacy endpoint provenance ignored by
        Reasoning V4.6.
    local_safety_authority: Always false in Stage-A.
    producer_contract_id: Versioned upstream producer identity.
    producer_contract_version: Exact upstream producer version.
BevRouteEvidenceV4.title: BevRouteEvidenceV4

DirectionAffordanceV4.description:
Describe physical FPV executability for one public probe direction.

Args:
    direction_label: Direction from the active affordance-probe profile.
    affordance: Coarse physical executability state.
    clearance: Coarse visible physical clearance.
    limiting_factors: Physical factors only; traffic rules are forbidden.
DirectionAffordanceV4.title: DirectionAffordanceV4

DirectionContextV4.description:
Select approved action and affordance-probe profiles.

Args:
    action_profile_id: Canonical fine action-profile identifier.
    action_profile_version: Exact action-profile version.
    affordance_probe_profile_id: Canonical probe identifier.
    affordance_probe_profile_version: Exact probe version.
DirectionContextV4.title: DirectionContextV4

DirectionGeometrySupervisionV1.description:
Carry private continuous geometry without overloading a discrete label.

Args:
    profile_id: Direction profile used to quantize ``raw_angle_deg``.
    profile_version: Frozen version of that profile.
    label_index: Strong direction index the geometry must reproduce.
    label_name: Strong direction name the geometry must reproduce.
    is_stop: Whether this row has the discrete stop label.
    raw_angle_deg: Continuous pre-binning angle; absent for stop or when
        the upstream source did not retain raw geometry.
    displacement: Recorded terminal-reference displacement, if retained.
    stop_threshold: Profile displacement threshold used by the producer.
    coordinate_frame: Declared x/y convention used by the producer.
    coordinate_unit: Unit of ``displacement``.
    nearest_boundary_deg: Nearest midpoint between moving candidates.
    boundary_distance_deg: Absolute distance to that midpoint.
    boundary_ambiguity_threshold_deg: Boundary-distance threshold below
        which this sample is sampling-ambiguous.
    confidence: Sampling/metric confidence state, independent of language
        supervision eligibility.
    angle_valid: Whether a continuous non-stop angle is trustworthy.
    confidence_weight: Future auxiliary-loss and sampling weight. Current
        Stage-I LM loss intentionally does not consume this field.
    stop_rule_verified: Whether retained displacement agrees with the
        profile's stop rule. Missing displacement is represented as false.
    source: Recorded direction producer identity.
    derivation_version: Version of this sidecar construction rule.
DirectionGeometrySupervisionV1.title: DirectionGeometrySupervisionV1

DirectionSupervisionV4.description: Carry one complete deterministic direction label.
DirectionSupervisionV4.title: DirectionSupervisionV4

EvidenceCatalogEntryV4.description:
Describe one prompt-visible raw input item.

Args:
    ref: Stable input-envelope reference.
    modality: Input modality.
    summary: Optional prompt-visible summary.
    attributes: Prompt-visible producer metadata.
    bev_route_evidence: Optional BEV presentation declaration.
EvidenceCatalogEntryV4.title: EvidenceCatalogEntryV4

InputModalitiesV4.description:
Record which Stage-A inputs are present.

Args:
    fpv: Current FPV is mandatory.
    history_fpv: One or more history FPV images are input only.
    instruction: An instruction is visible.
    bev: A BEV image is visible.
    goal_image: A goal image is visible.
    pixel_goal: A pixel goal is visible.
    waypoint: A waypoint is visible.
InputModalitiesV4.title: InputModalitiesV4

InteractionConstraintGroundingV4.description:
Collect high-level behavior constraints without source binding.

Args:
    constraints: Current restrictions that can alter the short action.
InteractionConstraintGroundingV4.title: InteractionConstraintGroundingV4

InteractionConstraintV4.description:
Represent one high-level current behavior restriction.

For ``effect=avoid``, ``affected_direction_labels`` means directions whose
nominal local corridor requires a continuous detour.  It is not a forbidden
direction set.  Selecting one of those coarse directions remains valid only
with ``speed=slow`` and ``response=detour``; selecting ``stop`` safely
satisfies the constraint.

Args:
    kind: Open high-level behavior-constraint category.
    status: Whether the restriction is currently applicable or uncertain.
    effect: Required behavior response family.
    affected_direction_labels: Empty for a global constraint.  For avoid,
        the public directions requiring local avoidance/detour.
InteractionConstraintV4.title: InteractionConstraintV4

LocalTraversabilityV4.description:
Collect physical affordances for the public probe vocabulary.

Args:
    direction_affordances: At most one record per probe direction.
LocalTraversabilityV4.title: LocalTraversabilityV4

NavigationContextGroundingV4.description:
Store only the visible Stage-A route direction context.

Args:
    task_direction: Nullable prompt-visible movement direction.
NavigationContextGroundingV4.title: NavigationContextGroundingV4

ReasoningTargetV4.description:
Wrap the canonical trace used as a training audit sidecar.

Args:
    reasoning: Exact six-section V4.6 trace.  V4.6 has no Finish object.
ReasoningTargetV4.title: ReasoningTargetV4

ReasoningTraceV4.description:
Canonical six-section shared-input Reasoning V4.6 trace.

Args:
    schema_version: Exact V4.6 semantic contract stamp.
    task_grounding: Deterministically normalized task.
    scene_grounding: Coarse visible scene summary.
    local_traversability: Physical direction affordances.
    navigation_context_grounding: Visible task direction.
    interaction_constraint_grounding: High-level behavior restrictions.
    decision: One consistent short-horizon action tuple.
ReasoningTraceV4.title: ReasoningTraceV4

SceneGroundingV4.description:
Summarize the visible navigation environment without object binding.

Args:
    scene_type: Open coarse scene code such as ``urban_sidewalk``.
    walkable_support: Open visible support code such as ``crosswalk``.
    key_entities: Open categories that materially affect local navigation.
    traffic_context: Open coarse traffic-control context code.
SceneGroundingV4.title: SceneGroundingV4

StageIAnswerabilityV1.description:
Store task-specific safe-projection gates.

Args:
    full_cot: The complete six-section target remains answerable.
    vqa: The atomic question retains all required visible evidence.
    decision: The Decision target has an approved visible authority.
    reasons: Deterministic admission facts, never free-form rationale.
StageIAnswerabilityV1.title: StageIAnswerabilityV1

StageIDecisionViewV1.description:
Carry one Decision-only LM target without a FullCoT teacher prefix.

Args:
    task_type: Always ``decision``.
    decision: Exact canonical V4.6 Decision tuple.
    direction_context: Public direction profiles.
    direction_supervision: Complete strong direction stamp.
    decision_authority: Visible authority admitted by the projector.
StageIDecisionViewV1.title: StageIDecisionViewV1

StageIFullCoTViewV1.description:
Carry one safe complete Reasoning V4.6 FullCoT view.

Args:
    task_type: Always ``full_cot``.
    reasoning_target: Exact canonical six-section target.
    direction_context: Public direction profiles.
    direction_supervision: Private strong stamp retained only as audit sidecar.
    prompt_profile_id: Canonical Reasoning V4.6 student prompt.
    prompt_policy_digest: Exact prompt-policy digest.
StageIFullCoTViewV1.title: StageIFullCoTViewV1

StageILossSpanV1.description:
Assign one binary LM-loss channel to a character interval.

The interval is half-open: ``[start, end)``.

Args:
    start: Inclusive Unicode character offset.
    end: Exclusive Unicode character offset.
    scale: Binary Stage I token-loss scale.
    channel: Semantic loss channel for audit and metrics.
StageILossSpanV1.title: StageILossSpanV1

StageIModalityAvailabilityV1.description:
Record native optional-modality availability before training dropout.

Args:
    current_fpv: Current FPV is mandatory for every Stage I view.
    history_fpv: At least one history FPV image is native input.
    instruction: A prompt-visible instruction is native input.
    bev: A prompt-visible BEV image is native input.
    goal_image: A goal image exists but is unsupported in Stage I v1.
    pixel_goal: A pixel goal exists but is unsupported in Stage I v1.
    waypoint: A waypoint exists but is dormant in Stage I v1.
StageIModalityAvailabilityV1.title: StageIModalityAvailabilityV1

StageIModalitySelectionV1.description:
Record the optional modalities retained by one training view.

Args:
    current_fpv: Current FPV is always retained.
    history_fpv: Retain native history FPV images.
    instruction: Retain the native instruction.
    bev: Retain native BEV images.
    goal_image: Always false in Stage I v1.
    pixel_goal: Always false in Stage I v1.
    waypoint: Always false in Stage I v1.
StageIModalitySelectionV1.title: StageIModalitySelectionV1

StageIModalityStateV1.description:
Expose whether each optional modality is present, absent, or dropped.

Args:
    history_fpv: State of history FPV.
    instruction: State of the instruction.
    bev: State of BEV.
    goal_image: State of goal-image input.
    pixel_goal: State of pixel-goal input.
    waypoint: State of waypoint input.
StageIModalityStateV1.title: StageIModalityStateV1

StageIVQAViewV1.description:
Carry one evidence-preserving answer-only VQA view.

Args:
    task_type: Always ``vqa``.
    question: Exact answer-independent VQA V2 question.
    annotation_id: Parent VQA annotation identity.
    annotation_evidence_refs: Exact evidence used by the annotation.
    label_source: Derived, weak, or external label source.
    source_kind: Open source-kind code.
    producer_id: Label producer identity.
    producer_version: Label producer version.
    prompt_profile_id: Exact VQA V2 student prompt.
    prompt_policy_digest: Exact VQA prompt-policy digest.
    capability_config_digest: Exact VQA activation snapshot.
StageIVQAViewV1.title: StageIVQAViewV1

TaskDirectionV4.description:

Args:
    status: Whether a prompt-visible direction is usable.

    direction: Public moving direction when status is ``aligned``.
TaskDirectionV4.title: TaskDirectionV4

TaskGroundingV4.description:
Store a canonical task taxonomy derived from the instruction.

Args:
    objective: Versioned normalized task objective.
    requirements: Explicit task-specific requirements only.
    ambiguities: Material task ambiguities, empty for the common template.
TaskGroundingV4.title: TaskGroundingV4

VQAQuestionV2.title: VQAQuestionV2
